items.definition:
The character and atmosphere of a place.
The restaurant had a lovely ambience with soft lighting and music.

an animal that can live both on land and in water
Frogs are amphibians.

a person who studies or is very fond of birds
The birdman spent hours observing the eagles.

the process of giving birth
She attended birthing classes to prepare for the baby's arrival.

foolish or absurd talk or ideas; nonsense
Don't talk such bosh; it's clearly not true.

a well-known sentence or phrase, typically one that is associated with a particular famous person
"May the Force be with you" is a famous catchphrase.

a small group of things, especially trees or plants, growing closely together
There was a small clump of trees at the edge of the field.

a plant that grows along the ground or up walls; a person who behaves in a strange or frightening way
The old house was covered in ivy and other creepers.

a device that reduces the force or effect of something; a disc or valve that regulates the flow of air or smoke
The news put a damper on our spirits.

a person who relies on another for financial support
He claimed his wife and children as dependants on his tax form.

a score of 40-40 in tennis; the two on a playing card or die
The tennis match went to deuce several times.

a device or program that enables a computer to imitate the functions of another computer system
He used an emulator to play old console games on his PC.

the action of enrolling or being enrolled in the armed services
His enlistment in the army changed his life.

conditions for movement or progress
The going was tough, but they persevered.

the main performer or attraction
The band was the headliner at the music festival.

a violent young troublemaker, typically one of a gang
The police arrested the football hooligans.

a feeling or state of despair; lack of hope
She felt a deep sense of hopelessness after losing her job.

a person who owns or rents a house
Every householder is responsible for their own waste disposal.

A Japanese martial art.
He practices jitsu to improve his self-defense skills.

A juvenile; a young person, especially a delinquent.
The juve was arrested for shoplifting.

A building housing a tomb or tombs.
The ancient mausoleum was an impressive structure.

The art of public speaking.
His powerful oratory captivated the audience.

A spacecraft designed to orbit a celestial body without landing on it.
The Mars orbiter sent back stunning images of the planet's surface.

the art of paper folding
She made a beautiful crane using origami.

a bird's feathers
The peacock displayed its magnificent plumage.

a person who hunts or catches game or fish illegally
Wildlife rangers are working to stop elephant poachers.

a person or thing that raises something
She is a successful fundraiser for the charity.

a substance that deters insects or other pests
Don't forget to pack insect repellent for the camping trip.

a native or inhabitant of Rwanda
Many Rwandans are working to rebuild their country.

ocean floor
Divers explored the seabed for ancient artifacts.

minor or distracting event
The argument became a sideshow, distracting from the main issue.

abattoir
Animals are processed in a slaughterhouse.

person who speculates financially
The real estate speculator bought several properties.

device or substance that maintains stability
The ship's stabilizers reduced the rolling motion.

a type of tree
The old sycamore tree provided shade in the park.

weight in tons
The ship's tonnage was impressive.

a serious infectious disease
He was diagnosed with typhoid fever.

the soft padded covering of furniture
The old sofa needed new upholstery.

an unexpected amount of money
The lottery win was a huge windfall for them.

a substance that induces insensitivity to pain
The dentist gave me an anaesthetic before extracting the tooth.

an artificial channel for conveying water, typically in the form of a bridge supported by tall columns across a valley or other gap
The ancient Romans built impressive aqueducts.

a short, stiff hair or filament
The brush had stiff bristles.

a person with whom one shares a secret or private matter, trusting them not to repeat it to others
She told her best friend, who was her closest confidant, everything.

a tropical disease transmitted by mosquitoes, causing fever and severe pain
She contracted dengue fever while traveling abroad.

a large number of people or animals moving together
A drove of tourists descended upon the small village.

the final point of a process or journey
We finally reached the endpoint of our long hike.

a cosmetic surgical procedure or a renovation
The old building received a much-needed facelift.

the mown part of a golf course between the tee and green
His golf ball landed perfectly in the middle of the fairway.

an overly enthusiastic male fan
He's a total fanboy of that superhero movie franchise.

a Spanish dance style
She loves to watch flamenco dancers perform.

the position of being a guardian
She was granted guardianship of her younger sister.

a person without professional or specialized knowledge in a particular subject
To a layman, the legal terms can be very confusing.

an easy shot in basketball; an easy task
He made an easy layup to win the game.

the action or process of magnifying something or being magnified
The microscope provides 100x magnification.

an object kept as a reminder or souvenir of a person or event
She kept the seashell as a memento of her trip to the beach.

illegally distilled or smuggled liquor
The old man used to make moonshine in the woods.

the performance of multiple tasks at one time
Multitasking can sometimes reduce overall productivity.

favoritism shown to family or friends in business or politics
Accusations of nepotism plagued the new administration.

the state of being normal
After the storm, life slowly returned to normality.

a person who supervises others, especially workers
The overseer checked the progress of the construction.

a member of a panel, especially in a discussion or game show
The panelist offered an insightful opinion.

a German armored vehicle, especially a tank
The panzer division advanced rapidly.

an occasion when a photographer takes photographs, typically of a person or people for a commercial purpose
The model prepared for her fashion photoshoot.

activities before a game
We had a pregame meal before heading to the stadium.
